page.pin.remember: Remember the PIN on the guest's device
page.login.heading: Admin Access
page.main.heading: Guest Tokens
page.main.port_warning_html: The add-on's Network port is disabled, so guest links can't be opened from outside Home Assistant. Enable it under Settings → Add-ons → HomePass → Network, or set a Guest URL.
page.activity.heading: Recent Activity
create.title: Create Guest Token
page.create.label: Label
page.create.slug_hint: Custom slugs are guessable. Use random slugs for external access.
page.create.countries_hint: Comma-separated ISO country codes. The link only opens from addresses registered to those countries, plus your home network. VPNs and roaming can move a guest across a border.
page.create.pin_hint: Guests must enter this before the link shows anything.
page.create.remember_pin_hint: Off, the guest enters the PIN again every time they reopen the link.
page.create.device_binding_hint_html: The first browser to tap Use this device on the link keeps it; every other device is refused. A chat app's built-in browser counts as a separate device. Reset it from the token's card.
page.entity.title: Entity settings
page.entity.display_name_hint_html: Shown to the guest instead of the Home Assistant name. Leave blank to use .
page.entity.show_brightness_hint: Off by default — the guest gets on/off only.
page.entity.show_color_hint: Also off by default. The guest gets a colour wheel, a warm-cool slider, or both — whichever Home Assistant reports the light supports.
page.entity.require_proximity: Require the guest to be at the property
page.entity.require_proximity_hint_html: Off by default. The guest's browser is asked for its location when they press this one control, and the command only goes through if that position falls inside Home Assistant's zone.home. Everything else on the link is unaffected.
page.entity.require_proximity_https: The guest link must be served over HTTPS — browsers withhold location on plain HTTP and the control will refuse. The position is self-reported by the browser, so treat this as a deterrent for a casual guest, not proof anyone is really there.
page.entity.local_network_hint_html: The guest can see this control from anywhere, but pressing it only works from . Ticked automatically for locks, covers and buttons. It relies on the client address your reverse proxy reports, the same as the IP allowlist.
page.template.title: Save Entity Template
page.template.name: Name
page.template.hint_html: Saves which entities are selected, nothing else — display names, light options and the location requirement stay with the token they were set on. Loading a template later adds its entities to whatever is already selected.
page.edit.title: Edit Entities
page.extend.hint: Replaces the current expiry with a new one from now.
timing.never_warn: This token grants permanent access until manually revoked.
page.extend.custom_error: Date must be in the future.
page.pin.title: PIN Protection
page.pin.hashed_hint: PINs are stored hashed and can never be shown again. Saving a new PIN — or removing one — signs out every guest who had already entered the old one, and retires every link without PIN.
page.pin.remember_hint: Saved as soon as you change it, separately from the PIN above. Off, the guest enters the PIN again every time they reopen the link — and anyone it was already remembered for is asked again now.
page.links.heading: Links without PIN
page.links.hint: Opens straight to the controls, skipping the keypad. Each link is shown once, when it is made — revoke or rotate one to sign out the devices that used it.
page.links.new_once: New link — copy it now, it will not be shown again:
page.schedule.title: Edit Schedule
page.schedule.hint: A guest who already has the link open is moved onto the new schedule straight away.
page.settings.hint: Changes apply straight away, no restart. A value saved here overrides the add-on option until you revert it. Credentials and the Home Assistant connection stay in the add-on configuration.
page.qr.title: QR Code
tokens.none_body: Create a token to give guests temporary access.
action.rotate_title: Issue a new link and retire this one
action.copy_without_pin_title: Make a new link that skips the PIN and copy it
action.qr_without_pin_title: Make a new link that skips the PIN and show its QR code
action.unbind_title: Let the next device to open the link claim it
picker.no_templates: No saved templates yet. Pick some entities, then Save selection.
picker.gated: Guest must be at the property
picker.no_selected_match: No selected entities match this filter
suggest.access_title: Add every lock, plus doors, gates and garage doors among covers and buttons
suggest.lights_title: Add every light, plus switches named as a light or lamp
suggest.added.one: Added {n} suggested entity — review before saving
suggest.added.other: Added {n} suggested entities — review before saving
suggest.none_access: No new doors & locks to suggest
template.select_first: Select at least one entity first.
template.delete_body: "{name}" will be removed. Tokens already created from it are unaffected.
timing.single_use_hint: Stops working once it has been used.
timing.period_hint: Works between a start and an end.
timing.single_use_detail: A use is one control the guest presses. Opening the link does not count — nor does a chat app loading it to show a preview. A link with only cameras and sensors on it is never used up.
timing.countdown_hint: The link can be sent well before it opens; the guest sees a countdown until then.
timing.advanced: Advanced: only on certain days and times
timing.advanced_hint_html: Inside the period above, the link only works during these weekly times, in the house's time zone ({zone}). An end earlier than the start runs past midnight; end at 00:00 to run to midnight.
timing.zone_unknown: unknown — windowed links refuse access until Home Assistant reports one
timing.err_uses: Uses must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
timing.err_end_future: The end must be in the future.
timing.err_end_after: The end must be after the start.
timing.err_no_windows: Add a weekly time, or turn the advanced option off.
timing.err_no_days: Pick at least one day for each weekly time.
timing.err_window_times: Each weekly time needs a start and an end.
timing.err_window_same: A weekly time must start and end at different times.
duplicate.title: Duplicate Guest Token
duplicate.label: {label} copy
pin.state_none: No PIN is set — this link opens straight away.
pin.asked: PIN will be asked every visit
links.qr_note: Anyone who scans this skips the PIN. Revoke it under PIN Protected if it goes astray.
links.rotate_confirm_body: This link stops working and every device that opened it is asked for the PIN. A new link with the same label is shown once.
links.revoke_confirm_body: This link stops working and every device that opened it is asked for the PIN.
extend.invalid: Invalid expiry date. Must be in the future.
revoke.title: Revoke Token
revoke.body: Active guest sessions will be disconnected immediately.
activate.body: "{label}" starts working immediately and a guest already waiting on the link is let in at once. Its expiry does not move.
rotate.body: A new link is generated and the current one stops working immediately. Entities, expiry, PIN and history are kept — a guest with a PIN will be asked for it again, and links without PIN are retired.
binding.on_body: "{label}" will only work on the first device that claims it. A guest already using the link is asked to claim it on their next load.
binding.off_body: "{label}" will work on any device holding the link again, and the current device claim is released.
unbind.body: The device holding "{label}" is disconnected, and the next device to open the link and tap "Use this device" claims it. To keep the link from the current holder altogether, use Rotate Link instead.
delete.title: Delete Token
delete.body: This will permanently remove the token record.
settings.app_name_hint: Shown to guests on their link and in the installed app.
settings.contact_message_hint: Shown when a guest link has expired or been revoked.
settings.guest_url_hint: External base address for guest links. Leave empty to use the local address.
settings.retention_hint: Older access-log entries are deleted automatically.
page.lang.label: Language
page.lang.hint: For this browser only, and applied straight away. Automatic follows the languages your browser asks for.
